title: Cold rebuild: tests that catch the bugs
summary: Write the shipping tests again from an empty editor, against the same planted bugs.

steps.title: Cold rebuild
body: Time to prove it stuck. In *What tests are for* you wrote tests for `Shipping.Cost` that caught three planted bugs. Now write them again from an **empty editor**: no starter, no hints, no solution. The planted bugs are the same.
Pulling it out of memory is what makes it stay. If you get stuck, go back to the lesson, then try again tomorrow.

steps.title: Rebuild the shipping tests cold
prompt: `Shipping.Cost(decimal total)` returns `0m` for orders of 50 or more and `4.99m` below that.
Write `public class ShippingTests` with at least three `[Fact]` tests that pass on the real code and fail on each planted bug.
